Asset type: high-quality illustrated mobile hotpot tile-puzzle background, tall portrait 720:1520.
Primary request: Create 敦煌流金, an immersive richly painted Dunhuang-inspired banquet alcove, with new culturally inspired materials and ornaments. The supplied images are only references for the exact composition and painterly craftsmanship. This is a full new environment, not a recolor.
Composition invariants: preserve tall portrait aspect 720:1520. Header drape and decorated arch occupy y=0–14%. A massive EMPTY light sandy-ivory center is reserved for gameplay, x=10–90%, y=16–73.5%; no objects, characters or strong decoration in the middle. Keep every ornamental element at the far frame edges only. Straight tabletop horizon starts at y=73.5%, filling bottom. At lower left a partially cropped traditional copper hotpot with red broth; at lower right a blue ceramic chopstick holder with chopsticks and a small folded patterned textile, other props tiny. No tray.
Scene: deep terracotta and desert-turquoise layered silk at the header; gold lotus, delicate stylized cloud and geometric border patterns along its edge. Sandstone carved slender posts at far left and right, ornate bronze hanging lamps emitting warm light at top corners. Delicate turquoise-and-gold beaded tassels, desert dried twig/lotus stem decorations only at sides. Central wall or parchment is pale sandy ivory with soft mineral plaster texture, nearly blank. Desert amber wood tabletop, rich brass and copper hotpot, turquoise ceramic chopstick pot and terracotta cloth at lower right.
Style: detailed painterly casual mobile game illustration, luminous gold and mineral pigments, tactile woven silk, carved sandstone, glowing bronze, fine traditional decorative pattern at edges. Warm, luxurious, beautifully crafted. No flying figures, no humans. Not flat vector, not realistic photography.
Text: absolutely none.
Constraints: NO letters, text, logos, watermarks, Chinese characters, numbers, UI, cards, buttons, trays, phone borders, food tile cards, menus. Keep the central 80% clean and empty for overlaying game UI. Match tabletop height, side-prop scale and overall source aspect.
